title: Insulin Pump Program Patient Relations Clause: Payment-History Courtesy on a Non-Covered Item
content:
**Clause.** A non-covered item charge on an Insulin Pump Program, posted for the line a CO-151 claim denial bills, follows the program's payments:

- where a payment posted in the three months before today and another in the three months before those, the charge is reduced by 5 percent (the payment-history percent);
- where a payment posted in the six months before today but not in both of those three-month spans, the charge is reduced by 2.5 percent (half the payment-history percent);
- otherwise there is no payment-history courtesy.

The payments read are the customer payments posted on the pump program. A record counts as in a number of months before today when its date is later than the same day of the month that many months before today, so a record dated exactly that many months before today is outside the window.

| Payments in the 3 months before today | Payments in the 3 months before those | Courtesy |
|---|---|---|
| at least one | at least one | 5 percent |
| at least one | none | 2.5 percent |
| none | at least one | 2.5 percent |
| none | none | none |
